recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and long-sleeve shirt, set against a vertically split background of dark textured navy and warm terracotta. The lighting is soft but directional, emphasizing facial contours and a goatee, with typography placed horizontally across the chest area.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical split of the background aligns with the subject's central axis.
The black of the hat and shirt creates a unified silhouette against the dual-tone backdrop.
Typography bridges the dark and light halves of the composition.
Warm skin tones harmonize with the terracotta background segment.
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a wide brim
Horizontal text placement across the lower third of the subject
Direct, calm eye contact with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face and the brim of the black cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the horizontal text line, then follow the vertical split of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced negative space on either side of the head, defined by the contrasting background colors.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black (clothing and hat) providing a strong silhouette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Terracotta orange and dark navy blue split background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted peach and off-white for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black clothing and the mid-tone background; low saturation overall for a rugged feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and deep neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color shifts to distinguish name from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic slab serif with sturdy, wide proportions.
Modern slab serif with clean geometry.
Geometric slab serif that maintains legibility at small sizes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a black cowboy hat and a black long-sleeve shirt. The background should be vertically split: the left side a textured dark navy blue, the right side a textured terracotta orange. Use soft directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase slab-serif text across the chest area. The first half of the text should be in a muted terracotta color, and the second half in off-white. Use wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a slab serif?
Is the subject wearing a black cowboy hat?
Is the text color split to match the background logic?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat brim does not obscure the eyes.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the background texture looks like painted plaster or canvas.
Confirm the color palette remains within earth tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Man in Black Cowboy Hat) + Background(Vertical Split Navy/Terracotta) + Typography(Horizontal Slab Serif with Wide Tracking) = Contemporary Country Aesthetic.
